delete_branch_on_merge.why: Merged PR branches are deleted on GitHub, so they don't pile up.

allow_squash_merge.why: Each PR lands on the default branch as one commit.

allow_merge_commit.why: Squash only keeps the default branch's history linear and one commit per PR.

allow_rebase_merge.why: Squash only keeps the default branch's history linear and one commit per PR.

secret_scanning.why: GitHub alerts on API keys and tokens committed by mistake.

secret_scanning_push_protection.why: Pushes that contain a known secret are blocked before they reach GitHub.

default_workflow_permissions.why: Workflows get a read-only token unless a workflow asks for more.

can_approve_pull_request_reviews.why: A workflow can't approve its own or anyone's PR.

description.why: The repo list and search results show what the repo is for.

ruleset.why: The default branch can't be deleted or force-pushed, and changes reach it only through a squash-merged PR.
